suggestions.title: Compare exact-date refundable rates; do not treat a snapshot as a booking-time forecast
suggestions.idea: Booking.com amounts shown on the Hotels page were captured on 2026-11-26 for specific dates and room types. Before booking, repeat the exact-date search and verify bed choice, attached bath, final tax-inclusive total, payment timing, and cancellation deadline. One capture cannot establish the cheapest day to purchase.
suggestions.tradeoff: A flexible rate may cost more, and the quoted amount may no longer be available. Neither a future price increase nor a saving is guaranteed.

suggestions.title: If choosing the 14-day / 13-night option, visit Beijing first and Shanghai second
suggestions.idea: The in-scope dual-city example is Beijing Feb 15–22 (7 nights), followed by Shanghai Feb 22–28 (6 nights). It includes Lantern Festival on Feb 20 during the Beijing week. This is a 14-day / 13-night planning option, not a claim that these are the cheapest dates; no quote was captured for the Shanghai six-night stay (check-in Feb 22, checkout Feb 28).
suggestions.tradeoff: This uses the full 14-day limit and adds a city transfer. Exact Shanghai six-night hotel rates and room availability must be re-quoted before choosing it.

suggestions.category: Beijing Base Strategy — Geography, Not Route-Time Advice
suggestions.title: Compare Dongcheng and Chaoyang if dining priorities differ
suggestions.idea: Chaoyang has 20 of Beijing’s 33 starred restaurants; Dongcheng has 9. Grand Millennium and Kempinski are listed in Chaoyang, while Park Plaza and base-Beijing are in Dongcheng. These are venue and hotel locations, not proof of hotel-to-venue journey times; the requested ≤60-minute route test remains unverified.
suggestions.tradeoff: The hotel order is provisional. Route times to central-axis museums, Sanlitun restaurants, or any finalist were not captured; verify exact official routes before selecting a base.

suggestions.title: Use the serviced apartment’s laundry amenity during a two-city stay
suggestions.idea: The 2026-11-26 Booking.com listing for base-Beijing Wangfujing described a private washing machine and kitchenette in its quoted studio; this could help on the Beijing leg of a 13-night trip. Recheck the selected room’s amenities before booking.
suggestions.tradeoff: This is an amenity-based suggestion, not a reason to extend the trip. The serviced-apartment format has different services from a full-service hotel; confirm current room details directly on the listing.

suggestions.title: Pair High-Value MICHELIN Lunches with 1–2 Signature Tasting Dinners
suggestions.idea: Book 1* Yi Long Court's verified Dim Sum Lunch Set at The Peninsula Shanghai (CNY 596 base / CNY 694.94 all-in for 2), ¥¥ 2* Canton 8 in Shanghai, and ¥¥ 1* Poetry·Wine or The Beijing Kitchen in Beijing alongside your bucket-list 3* splurge.
suggestions.tradeoff: Preserves budget for 3* Xin Rong Ji / 3* Chao Shang Chao / 3* Taian Table without paying ¥¥¥¥ dinner tariffs every night.

suggestions.title: Use Shanghai Museum East (OPEN Mondays!) + Met Jewelry Exhibition as Your Monday Arrival Anchor
suggestions.idea: While Shanghai Museum West, Yu Garden, Da Vittorio, and Sir Elly's are closed Mondays, Shanghai Museum East in Pudong (Line 2) is OPEN Mondays and hosts the Met Museum co-curated 'Jewelry: The Body Transformed' show through 2027-05-05.
suggestions.tradeoff: Closes Tuesdays instead — keep Tuesday for People's Square West Museum & Yu Garden.

suggestions.category: Out of Scope Unless It Fits the 1–2-Week Limit
suggestions.title: Keep any optional day trip inside the chosen 7–14-day itinerary
suggestions.idea: A third city or overnight regional extension is not part of the current recommendation. A future same-day side trip should be added only after official rail, attraction hours, fares, and travel times are verified and the selected plan still fits within 14 days / 13 nights.
suggestions.tradeoff: No Suzhou, Hangzhou, Xi’an, or Chengdu route is verified in this planner; no such trip is included or costed. Expanding to one would require a new research pass.
